s.d: πεντακισ-χίλιοι, -αι, -α five thousand: [[matthew 14 21|Mat.14:21 16:9]], [[mark 6 44|Mrk.6:44 8:19]], [[luke 9 14|Luk.9:14]], [[john 6 10|Jhn.6:10]].† (AS)
πεντακόσιοι, -αι, -α five hundred: [[luke 7 41|Luk.7:41]], [[1-corinthians 15 6|1Co.15:6]].† (AS)
πέντε indecl., οἱ, αἱ, τά, five: [[matthew 14 17|Mat.14:17]], al (AS)
πεντε-και-δέκατος, -η, -ον the fifteenth: [[luke 3 1|Luk.3:1.]]† (AS)
πεντήκοντα indecl., οἱ, αἱ, τά, fifty: [[luke 7 41|Luk.7:41 16:6]], [[john 8 57|Jhn.8:57 21:11]], [[acts 13 20|Act.13:20]]; ἀνὰ π., [[luke 9 14|Luk.9:14;]] κατὰ π., [[mark 6 40|Mrk.6:40.]]† (AS)

πεντηκοστός, -ή, -όν [in LXX for חֲמִישִׁי, חֲמִישִׁי, [[leviticus 25 10|Lev.25:10-11]], [[2-kings 15 23|4Ki.15:23 15:27]]; 1Ma.4:1-61, 2Ma.14:4; ἡ π., Tob.2:1, 2Ma.12:32 * ;] fiftieth. As subst., ἡ π.; (a) (sc. μερίς), at Athens, a tax of two per cent.; (b) (sc. ἡμέρα, i.e. the fiftieth day after the Passover), Pentecost, the second of the three great Jewish feasts (To, 2Mac, ll. with; ἑορτὴ ἑβδομάδων, [[deuteronomy 16 10|Deu.16:10]], al.) : [[acts 2 1|Act.2:1 20:16]], [[1-corinthians 16 8|1Co.16:8]].† (AS)

πεποίθησις, -εως, ἡ (πείθω), [in LXX: [[2-kings 18 19|4Ki.18:19]] (בִּטָּחוֹן)* ;] confidence: [[2-corinthians 1 15|2Co.1:15 3:4 10:2]], [[ephesians 3 12|Eph.3:12]]; before εἰς, [[2-corinthians 8 22|2Co.8:22;]] ἐν, [[philippians 3 4|Php.3:4]] (the word is condemned by the Atticists, see Rutherford, NPhr., 355).† (AS)

πέρ (akin to περί), enclitic particle, adding force or positiveness to the word which precedes it: indeed, by far, etc. In the NT, it is always affixed to the word to which it relates, see: διόπερ, άἐνπερ, εἴπερ, ἐπείπερ, ἐπειδήπερ, ἤπερ, καθάπερ, καίπερ, ἅσπερ, ὥσπερ ὥσ-περ adv., just as, even as: [[matthew 6 2|Mat.6:2 20:28]], [[acts 3 17|Act.3:17]], [[1-corinthians 8 5|1Co.8:5]], [[1-thessalonians 5 3|1Th.5:3]] al.; in protasis, with οὕτως (καί) in apodosis: [[matthew 12 40|Mat.12:40]], [[luke 17 24|Luk.17:24]], [[john 5 21|Jhn.5:21]], [[romans 5 19|Rom.5:19]], [[galatians 4 29|Gal.4:29]], [[james 2 26|Jas.2:26]], al (AS)

πέραν adv., [in LXX for עֵבֶר and cognate forms ;] on the other side, across (usually with the idea of water lying between); (a) as in the older poets, as prep. with genitive: τ. θαλάσσης, [[john 6 1|Jhn.6:1, 17 6:22, 25]]; τ. Ἰορδάνου, [[matthew 4 15|Mat.4:15]] (LXX), [[matthew 4 25|Mat.4:25 19:1]], [[mark 3 8|Mrk.3:8 10:1]], [[john 1 28|Jhn.1:28 3:26 10:40]]; τ. χειμάρρου τ. Κέδρων, [[john 18 1|Jhn.18:1;]] (b) τὸ π., the region beyond, the other side: [[matthew 8 18|Mat.8:18, 28 14:22 16:5]], [[mark 4 35|Mrk.4:35 5:21 6:45 8:13]]; τ. θαλάσσης, [[mark 5 1|Mrk.5:1;]] τ. λίμνης, [[luke 8 22|Luk.8:22.]]† (AS)

πέρας, -ατος, τό (πέρα, beyond), [in LXX chiefly for קֵץ, קָצָה and cognate forms ;] an end, limit, boundary; (a) of space: chiefly in pl., τὰ π. τ. γῆς, [[matthew 12 42|Mat.12:42]], [[luke 11 31|Luk.11:31]]; τ. οἰκουμένης, [[romans 10 18|Rom.10:18]] (LXX); (b) (opposite to ἀρχή) the end: with genitive, ἀντιλογίας, [[hebrews 6 10|Heb.6:10.]]† (AS)

Πέργαμος, -ου, ἡ (so Xen., Paus., al., but -ον, τό in Strabo, Polyb., and most writers, also in Inscr.; in NT the termination is uncertain) Pergamum, a city of Mysia: [[revelation 1 11|Rev.1:11 2:12]].† (AS)
Πέργη, -ης, ἡ Perga, a city of Pamphylia: [[acts 13 13|Act.13:13-14 14:25]].† (AS)

περί, prep. with genitive, accusative (in cl. also with dative; cf. M, Pr., 105f.), with radical sense round about (as distinct from ἀμφί, on both sides). I. C. genitive, 1. of place, about (poët.). 2. Causal, about, on account of, concerning, in reference to: [[matthew 2 8|Mat.2:8]], [[mark 1 44|Mrk.1:44]], [[luke 4 38|Luk.4:38]], [[john 16 26|Jhn.16:26]], [[acts 28 21|Act.28:21]], al. mult.; τὰ περί, with genitive, the things concerning one, one's state or case: [[mark 5 27|Mrk.5:27]], [[acts 1 3|Act.1:3 28:15]], [[ephesians 6 22|Eph.6:22]], al.; at the beginning of a sentence, περί, regarding, as to, [[1-corinthians 7 1|1Co.7:1]], al.; in the sense on account of ([[matthew 26 28|Mat.26:28]], [[1-corinthians 1 13|1Co.1:13]], al.), often with ὑπέρ as variant (cf. M, Pr., 105). II. C. accusative, 1. of place, about, around: [[matthew 3 4|Mat.3:4]], [[mark 1 6|Mrk.1:6]], [[luke 13 8|Luk.13:8]], [[acts 22 6|Act.22:6]], al.; οἱ περί, with accusative of person(s), of one's associates, friends, etc., [[mark 4 10|Mrk.4:10]], [[luke 22 49|Luk.22:49]], [[john 11 19|Jhn.11:19]], [[acts 13 13|Act.13:13]]; οἱ περὶ τ. τοιαῦτα ἐργάται, [[acts 19 25|Act.19:25;]] metaphorically, about, as to, concerning: [[1-timothy 1 19|1Ti.1:19 6:4]] [[2-timothy 2 18|2Ti.2:18 3:8]], [[titus 2 7|Tit.2:7]]; τὰ περὶ ἐμέ, [[philippians 2 23|Php.2:23;]] αἱ περὶ τ. λοιπὰ ἐπιθυμίαι, [[mark 4 19|Mrk.4:19.]] 2. Of time, in a loose reckoning, about, near: [[matthew 20 3|Mat.20:3, 5 6, 9 27:46]], [[mark 6 48|Mrk.6:48]], [[acts 10 3|Act.10:3, 9 22:6]]. III. In composition: round about (περιβάλλω, περίκειμαι), beyond, over and above (περιποιέω, περιλείπω), to excess (περιεργάζομαι, περισσεύω). (AS)

περι-άγω [in LXX: [[amos 2 10|Amo.2:10]] (הָלַךְ hi.); [[isaiah 28 27|Isa.28:27]], [[ezekiel 47 2|Eze.47:2]] (סָבַב hi., ho.); [[ezekiel 37 2|Eze.37:2 46:21]] (עָבַר hi), 2Ma.4:38 2Mac 6:10 * ;] 1. to lead about or around: with accusative of person(s), [[1-corinthians 9 5|1Co.9:5.]] 2. Intrans., to go about: [[acts 13 11|Act.13:11;]] before ἐν, [[matthew 4 23|Mat.4:23;]] with accusative loc. (governed by the περι-, not so in cl., see Bl., § 34, 1; 53, 1), [[matthew 9 35|Mat.9:35 23:15]], [[mark 6 6|Mrk.6:6]].† (AS)

περι-αιρέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for סוּר hi. ;] to take away that which surrounds, take away, take off (τείχη, Hdt., Thuc.; χιτῶνα, Plat.; δακτύλιον, [[genesis 41 42|Gen.41:42]], cf. σφρηγῖδα, Hdt., ii, 151) : τ. κάλυΜΜα, pass., [[2-corinthians 3 16|2Co.3:16;]] as nautical term (RV, cast off), ἀγκύρας, [[acts 27 40|Act.27:40;]] absol., to cast loose: [[acts 28 13|Act.28:13.]] Metaphorical, to take away entirely: ἐλπίς, pass., [[acts 27 20|Act.27:20;]] ἁμαρτίας, [[hebrews 10 11|Heb.10:11.]]† (AS)
περι-αστράπτω [in LXX: 4Ma.4:10 * ;] to flash around: with accusative, [[acts 9 3|Act.9:3;]] before περί [[acts 22 6|Act.22:6]] (Eccl, and Byzant.).† (AS)

περι-βάλλω [in LXX chiefly for כָּסָה pi., also for לָבַשׁ, עָטָה, etc. ;] to throw around or over, put on or over; (a) of siege or defen­sive works: χάρακά σοι, [[luke 19 43|Luk.19:43]] (WH, mg.; παρεμβ-, WH, txt.); (b) of clothing, to put on, wrap about, clothe with: with accusative of thing(s), [[luke 23 11|Luk.23:11;]] with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 25 36|Mat.25:36, 38 25:43]]; with dupl. accusative (not cl.; Bl., § 34, 4), [[john 19 2|Jhn.19:2;]] pf. pass., to have wrapped round one: with accusative of thing(s) (cl.), [[mark 14 51|Mrk.14:51 16:5]], [[revelation 7 9|Rev.7:9, 13 10:1 11:3 12:1 17:4 18:16 19:13]]; with dative of thing(s), [[revelation 4 4|Rev.4:4]] (WH, txt.; before ἐν, WH, mg.); fut., before ἐν (of. [[deuteronomy 22 12|Deu.22:12]], [[psalms 45 9|Psa.45:9, 13]]), [[revelation 3 5|Rev.3:5]]. Mid., to clothe oneself, wrap round or put on oneself: absol., [[matthew 6 29|Mat.6:29]], [[luke 12 27|Luk.12:27]], [[revelation 3 18|Rev.3:18]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 6 31|Mat.6:31]], [[acts 12 8|Act.12:8]], [[revelation 19 8|Rev.19:8]].† (AS)

περι-βλέπω [in LXX for שׁוּר, etc. ;] to look around (at). Mid., to look about one (at) : absol., [[mark 9 8|Mrk.9:8 10:23]]; with inf., [[mark 5 32|Mrk.5:32;]] with accusative of person(s), [[mark 3 5|Mrk.3:5, 34]], [[luke 6 10|Luk.6:10]]; πάντα, [[mark 11 11|Mrk.11:11.]]† (AS)

περι-βόλαιον, -ου, τό (περιβάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for כְּסוּת, לְבוּשׁ and cognate forms ;] that which is thrown around, a covering, in NT, (a) a mantle ([[psalms 102 27|Psa.102:27]], [[isaiah 59 17|Isa.59:17]], al.) : [[hebrews 1 12|Heb.1:12]]" (LXX) (b) a veil: [[1-corinthians 11 15|1Co.11:15]] (but see ICC, in l).† (AS)
περι-δέω [in LXX: [[job 12 18|Job.12:18]] (אָסַר)* ;] to tie round, bind round: with accusative and dative, pass., [[john 11 44|Jhn.11:44.]]† (AS)
περι-εργάζομαι [in LXX: Wis.8:5 א1, Sir.3:23 * ;] 1. to waste one's labour about a thing. 2. to be a busybody: [[2-thessalonians 3 11|2Th.3:11]] (cf. Plat., Apol., 19 B).† (AS)

περίεργος, -ον I. of persons; 1. over careful. 2. curious, meddling, a busybody: [[1-timothy 5 13|1Ti.5:13.]] II. Of things; 1. over-wrought. 2. super­fluous. 3. curious, uncanny; τὰ π., curious arts, magic: [[acts 19 19|Act.19:19]] (see Deiss., BS, 3235.).† (AS)

περι-έρχομαι [in LXX chiefly for סָבַב ;] to go about (as an itinerant): [[acts 19 13|Act.19:13 28:13]] (περιελόντες, WH, R, mg.), [[hebrews 11 37|Heb.11:37;]] τ. οἰκίας, from house to house: [[1-timothy 5 13|1Ti.5:13.]]† (AS)

περι-έχω, [in LXX for H661, H5362 hi., H6822 pi., etc. ;] 1. to surround, encompass: [[luke 5 9|Luk.5:9]] (cf. MM, xix). 2. to comprehend, include, contain, esp. of books: with accusative, [[acts 23 25|Act.23:25]], Rec.; accusative to a late usage, intrans. (BL, § 53, 1.3; MM, xix; Hort, in l), it stands written, [[1-peter 2 6|1Pe.2:6.]]† (AS)

περι-ζώννυμι and -ύω (see Veitch, see word), [in LXX chiefly for חָגַר, also for אָזַר, etc. ;] to gird (with dupl, accusative, as ὁ περιζωννύων με δύναμιν, [[psalms 18 32|Psa.18:32]]): pass., αἱ ὀσφύες περιεζωσμέναι, [[luke 12 35|Luk.12:35;]] π. ζώνην χρυσῆν, [[revelation 1 13|Rev.1:13 15:6]] (but see infr.). Mid., to gird oneself: [[luke 12 37|Luk.12:37 17:8]] (and so perh. Re, ll. with supr., cf. [[1-samuel 2 4|1Ki.2:4]]); with accusative of thing(s) (figuratively), τ. ὀσφύν, [[ephesians 6 14|Eph.6:14]] (before ἐν, cf. [[1-chronicles 15 27|1Ch.15:27]]).† (AS)
περί-θεσις, -εως, ἡ (περιτίθημι), [in Sm.: [[psalms 32 9|Psa.32:9]] * ;] a putting around, putting on: [[1-peter 3 3|1Pe.3:3.]]† (AS)

περι-ίστημι (Rec. ΐστημι) [in LXX: [[joshua 6 3|Jos.6:3]] (סָבַב), [[2-samuel 13 31|2Ki.13:31]] (נָצַב ni.), [[1-samuel 4 16|1Ki.4:16]], Ep. [[jeremiah 37 1|Jer.37:1-21]], Jdth.5:22, 2Ma.14:9 * ;] 1. to place around. 2. to stand around: [[john 11 42|Jhn.11:42;]] with accusative of person(s), [[acts 25 7|Act.25:7.]] Mid. (in late writers), to turn oneself about to avoid, to shun: with accusative of thing(s), [[2-timothy 2 16|2Ti.2:16]], [[titus 3 9|Tit.3:9]].† (AS)

περι-κάθαρμα, -τος, τό (περικαθαίρω, to purify on all sides or completely, [[deuteronomy 18 10|Deu.18:10]], [[joshua 5 4|Jos.5:4]], 4Ma.1:29*), [in LXX: [[proverbs 21 18|Pro.21:18]] (כֹּפֶר)* ;] 1. a victim, expiation (Pr, l.with). 2. refuse, rubbish: pl., [[1-corinthians 4 13|1Co.4:13]] (see ICC, in l).† (AS)

περι-καλύπτω [in LXX for כָּסָה pi., שָׁבַץ pu., etc. ;] to cover around, cover up or over. with accusative, [[mark 14 65|Mrk.14:65]], [[luke 22 64|Luk.22:64]]; pass., before χρυσίῳ, [[hebrews 9 4|Heb.9:4.]]† (AS)

περί-κειμαι [in LXX: Ep. Je 24, 58, 4Ma.12:3 * ;] 1. to lie round about: μύλος, λίθος (RV, were hanged about), [[mark 9 42|Mrk.9:42]], [[luke 17 2|Luk.17:2]]; νεφος μαρτύρων, [[hebrews 12 1|Heb.12:1.]] 2. to have around one, be clothed with: [[acts 28 20|Act.28:20;]] figuratively, ἀσθένειαν, [[hebrews 5 2|Heb.5:2.]]† (AS)

περι-κεφαλαία, -ας, ἡ [in LXX for כּוֹבַע, קוֹבַע ;] a helmet: figuratively, [[1-thessalonians 5 8|1Th.5:8;]] with genitive explic., π. τ. σωτηρίου, [[ephesians 6 17|Eph.6:17]] (cf. [[isaiah 59 17|Isa.59:17]]).† (AS)
περι-κρατής, -ές [in LXX: Da TH Sus 1:39 A * ;] having full command of: [[acts 27 16|Act.27:16.]]† (AS)
περι-κρύπτω to conceal entirely, keep hidden: late 2 aor., περιέκρυβσν (but see BL, § 17; Soph., Lex., see word περικρύβω), [[luke 1 24|Luk.1:24.]]† (AS)
περι-κυκλόω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for סָבַב ;] to encircle, encompass: of a besieged city, [[luke 19 43|Luk.19:43.]]† (AS)
περι-λάμπω to shine around: with accusative, [[luke 2 9|Luk.2:9]], [[acts 26 13|Act.26:13]].† (AS)

περι-λείπομαι depon. mid, and pass., [in LXX: [[2-chronicles 34 21|2Ch.34:21]] A (שָׁאַר ni.), 2Ma.1:31 2Mac 8:14, 4Ma.12:6 4Mac 13:18 * ;] to be left remaining, remain over, survive: [[1-thessalonians 4 15|1Th.4:15 4:17]]† (AS)

περί-λυπος, -ον [in LXX: [[psalms 42 5|Psa.42:5, 11]], I [[esther 8 69|Est.8:69]], al. ;] very sad, deeply grieved: [[matthew 26 38|Mat.26:38]], [[mark 6 26|Mrk.6:26 14:34]], [[luke 18 23|Luk.18:23]].† (AS)
περι-μένω [in LXX: [[genesis 49 18|Gen.49:18]] (קָוָה pi.), Wis.8:12 * ;] to wait for: with acce., [[acts 1 4|Act.1:4.]]† (AS)
πέριξ adv., [in Al.: [[leviticus 13 33|Lev.13:33]] * ;] round about: αἱ π. πολεῖς, [[acts 5 16|Act.5:16.]]† (AS)
περι-οικέω, -ῶ to dwell round about: with accusative, [[luke 1 65|Luk.1:65.]]† (AS)
περί-οικος, -ον [in LXX for כִּכָּר, etc. ;] dwelling around; as subst., ὁ π., a neighbour: [[luke 1 58|Luk.1:58]] (cf. πλησίον).† (AS)

περιούσιος, -ον (περίειμι, to be over and above), [in LXX: [[exodus 19 5|Exo.19:5 23:22]], [[deuteronomy 7 6|Deu.7:6 14:2 26:18]] (סְגֻלָּה, עַם)* ;] one's own, of one's own possession: λαὸς π. (cf. LXX, ll. with), [[titus 2 14|Tit.2:14.]]† (AS)
περι-οχή, -ῆς, ἡ (περιέχω), [in LXX for מָצוּד, מָצוֹר, etc. ;] 1. compass, circumference. 2. a portion circumscribed, a section: [[acts 8 32|Act.8:32.]]† (AS)

περι-πατέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ pi., hith. ;] to walk: absol., [[matthew 9 5|Mat.9:5]], [[mark 5 42|Mrk.5:42]], [[luke 5 23|Luk.5:23]], [[john 1 36|Jhn.1:36]]; with pred., γυμνός, [[revelation 16 15|Rev.16:15;]] ἐπάνω [[luke 11 44|Luk.11:44;]] διά, with genitive, [[revelation 21 24|Rev.21:24;]] ἐν, [[mark 11 27|Mrk.11:27 12:38]], [[john 7 1|Jhn.7:1 11:54]], [[revelation 2 1|Rev.2:1]], al.; ἐν τ. σκοτίᾳ, figuratively, [[john 8 12|Jhn.8:12 12:35]], [[1-john 1 6|1Jn.1:6-7]] [[john 2 11|Jn 2:11]]; ἐπί, with genitive, [[matthew 14 26|Mat.14:26;]] id. with dative, [[matthew 14 25|Mat.14:25, 29]]; μετά, [[john 6 66|Jhn.6:66]], [[revelation 3 4|Rev.3:4]]; παρά, with accusative, [[matthew 4 18|Mat.4:18.]] Metaphorical, of living, passing one's life, conducting oneself (like ἀναστρέφομαι in Xen., Plut., LXX, π.; M, [[proverbs 11 1|Pro.11:1-31;]] Deiss., BS, 194) : ἀκριβῶς, [[ephesians 5 15|Eph.5:15;]] ἀτάκτως, [[2-thessalonians 3 6|2Th.3:6 3:11]]; εὐσχημόνως, [[revelation 13 13|Rev.13:13]], [[1-thessalonians 4 12|1Th.4:12]]; ἀξίως, with genitive, [[ephesians 4 1|Eph.4:1]], [[colossians 1 10|Col.1:10]], [[1-thessalonians 2 12|1Th.2:12]]; καθώς (ὥς), [[ephesians 4 17|Eph.4:17 5:8, 15]], [[philippians 3 17|Php.3:17]], [[1-thessalonians 4 1|1Th.4:1]]; οὕτως ὥς, [[1-corinthians 7 17|1Co.7:17;]] before nom. qual., [[philippians 3 18|Php.3:18;]] with dative, [[acts 21 21|Act.21:21]], [[romans 13 13|Rom.13:13]], [[2-corinthians 12 18|2Co.12:18]], [[galatians 5 16|Gal.5:16]]; before ἐν, [[romans 6 4|Rom.6:4]], [[2-corinthians 4 2|2Co.4:2 5:7 10:3]], [[ephesians 2 2|Eph.2:2, 10 4:17 5:2]], [[colossians 3 7|Col.3:7 4:5]], [[hebrews 13 9|Heb.13:9]], 2Jn.4 Jn 6, al.; ἐν Χριστῷ, [[colossians 2 6|Col.2:6;]] κατά, with accusative, [[mark 7 5|Mrk.7:5]], [[romans 8 4|Rom.8:4 14:15]], [[1-corinthians 3 3|1Co.3:3]], [[2-corinthians 10 2|2Co.10:2]], 2Jn.6 (cf. ἐν-περιπατέω). (AS)
περι-πείρω to put on a spit, hence, to pierce: metaphorically, ἑαυτὸν . . . ὀδύναις, [[1-timothy 6 10|1Ti.6:10.]]† (AS)

περι-πίπτω [in LXX: [[ruth 2 3|Rut.2:3]], [[2-samuel 1 6|2Ki.1:6]] (קָרָה), [[proverbs 11 5|Pro.11:5]] (נָפַל), Dan LXX 2:9, 2Ma.6:13 2Mac 9:7 2Mac 9:21 2Mac 10:4 * ;] 1. to fall around. 2. to fall in with, light upon, come across: with dative, λῃσταῖς, [[luke 10 30|Luk.10:30;]] πειρασμοῖς, [[james 1 2|Jas.1:2;]] before εἰς, [[acts 27 41|Act.27:41.]]† (AS)

περι-ποιέω, -ῶ [in LXX for pi., hi., etc. ;] to make to remain over, preserve. Mid. (a) to keep or save for oneself: τ. ψυχήν (cf. Xen., Cyr., iv, 4, 10; Arist., Pol., v, 11, 30), [[luke 17 33|Luk.17:33;]] (b) to get or gain for oneself, get possession of (Thuc., Xen., al.) : [[acts 20 28|Act.20:28]], [[1-timothy 3 13|1Ti.3:13]].† (AS)

περι-ποίησις, -εως, ἡ (περιποιέω), [in LXX: [[2-chronicles 4 13|2Ch.4:13]] (12) (מִחְיָה) [[malachi 3 17|Mal.3:17]] (סְגֻלָּה), [[haggai 2 10|Hag.2:10]] (9) * ;] 1. preservation: [[hebrews 10 39|Heb.10:39]] (2 Ch, l.with). 2. acquisition, obtaining: [[1-thessalonians 5 9|1Th.5:9]], [[2-thessalonians 2 14|2Th.2:14]] (and so perh. [[ephesians 1 14|Eph.1:14]], see infr.). 3. a possession: [[ephesians 1 14|Eph.1:14]] (but see supr., and cf. ICC, in l), [[1-peter 2 9|1Pe.2:9]] (LXX).† (AS)
περι-ρήγνυμι (Rec. -ρρ-, see supr.) [in LXX: 2Ma.4:38 * ;] to break or tear off all around: frequently of garments, τ. ἰμάτια, [[acts 16 22|Act.16:22.]]† (AS)
περι-σπάω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for עָנָה ;] to draw around, draw off or away. Metaphorical, to distract: pass., [[luke 10 40|Luk.10:40.]]† (AS)

περισσεία, -ας, ἡ (περισσευω), [in LXX: [[ecclesiastes 12 1|Ecc.12:1-14]] (יִתְרוֹן and cogn. forms, [[ecclesiastes 1 3|Ecc.1:3]], al.) * ;] 1. abundance, superfluity: [[romans 5 17|Rom.5:17]], [[2-corinthians 8 2|2Co.8:2 10:15]], [[james 1 21|Jas.1:21]] (so also Inscr., see LAE, 80). 2. (a) superiority (Ec, see supr.); (b) profit (ib.).† (AS)

περίσσευμα, -τος, τό (περισσεύω) [in LXX: [[ecclesiastes 2 15|Ecc.2:15]] * ;] that which is over and above, superfluity, abundance: opposite to ὑστέρημα (which see), [[2-corinthians 8 13|2Co.8:13-14;]] pl., [[mark 8 8|Mrk.8:8;]] metaphorically, π. τ. καρδίας, [[matthew 12 34|Mat.12:34]], [[luke 6 45|Luk.6:45]] (cf. Ec, l.with; Plut., al.).† (AS)

περισσεύω (περισσός), [in LXX: [[1-samuel 2 33|1Ki.2:33]] (מַרְבִּית), [[1-kings 2 36|1Ki.2:36]] [[ecclesiastes 3 19|Ecc.3:19]] (יָתַר ni., יוׄתֵר), Tob.4:16, Sir.10:27 11:12 19:24, Sir 30:38 (Sir.33:29), 1Ma.3:30 * ;] I. Prop., intrans., 1. of things, to be over and above the number (Hes.), hence, (a) to be or remain over: [[matthew 14 20|Mat.14:20 15:37]], [[luke 9 17|Luk.9:17]], [[john 6 12|Jhn.6:12-13]]; (b) to abound, be in abundance: [[mark 12 44|Mrk.12:44]], [[luke 12 15|Luk.12:15 21:4]], [[acts 16 5|Act.16:5]], [[romans 3 7|Rom.3:7 5:15]], [[2-corinthians 1 5|2Co.1:5 8:2 9:12]], [[philippians 1 26|Php.1:26]]. 2. Of persons, (a) to abound in, have in abundance: [[1-corinthians 14 12|1Co.14:12 15:58]], [[philippians 4 12|Php.4:12, 18]]; with genitive, [[luke 15 17|Luk.15:17]] T; (b) to be superior or better, to excel: absol., [[1-corinthians 3 9|1Co.3:9 8:8]]; with dative ref., [[2-corinthians 3 9|2Co.3:9;]] before ἐν, [[romans 15 13|Rom.15:13]], [[1-corinthians 15 58|1Co.15:58]], [[2-corinthians 3 9|2Co.3:9 8:7]], [[colossians 2 7|Col.2:7]]; μᾶλλον, [[1-thessalonians 4 1|1Th.4:1 4:10]]; μ καὶ μ., [[philippians 1 9|Php.1:9;]] πλεῖον, [[matthew 5 20|Mat.5:20.]] II. In late writers (Lft., Notes, 48 f.), trans., (a) to make to abound: with accusative before εἰς, [[2-corinthians 4 15|2Co.4:15 9:8]], [[ephesians 1 8|Eph.1:8]]; pass., [[matthew 13 12|Mat.13:12 25:29]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[luke 15 17|Luk.15:17]], WH; (b) to make to excel: with accusative of person(s), dative of thing(s), [[1-thessalonians 3 12|1Th.3:12]] (cf. ὑπερ-περισσεύω).† SYN.: πλεονάζω (AS)

περισσός, -ή, -όν [in LXX for יֶתֶר and cogn. forms ;] 1. more than sufficient, over and above, abundant: [[john 10 10|Jhn.10:10]], [[2-corinthians 9 1|2Co.9:1]]; with genitive (a popular substitute for πλειών, Bl., § 11, 3.4), [[matthew 5 37|Mat.5:37;]] id. with ellips. genitive, [[matthew 5 47|Mat.5:47]] (EV, more than others; but see infr.); εκ περισσοῦ, [[mark 6 51|Mrk.6:51]], Rec., T. (on ὑπὲρ ὲκ π., see: ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ). Compar. neut., -ότερον: [[luke 12 4|Luk.12:4, 48]]; with genitive, [[mark 12 33|Mrk.12:33;]] adverbially (cf. περισσῶς), more abund­antly, [[2-corinthians 10 8|2Co.10:8]], [[hebrews 6 17|Heb.6:17 7:15]]; with genitive, π. πάντων, [[1-corinthians 15 10|1Co.15:10;]] pleonast., μᾶλλον π., [[mark 7 36|Mrk.7:36.]] 2. out of the common, pre-eminent, superior: [[matthew 5 47|Mat.5:47]] (Thayer, see word, but see supr.); τὸ π., as subst., [[romans 3 1|Rom.3:1;]] compar., -ότερος, with genitive, [[matthew 11 9|Mat.11:9]], [[luke 7 26|Luk.7:26]]; with subst., [[mark 12 40|Mrk.12:40]], [[luke 20 47|Luk.20:47]], [[1-corinthians 12 23|1Co.12:23-24]], [[2-corinthians 2 7|2Co.2:7]].† (AS)

περισσότερον, -ως, see: περισσῶς. περισσῶς adv. (περισσός) [in LXX: [[psalms 31 23|Psa.31:23]] (יֶתֶר -עַל), Da TH [[daniel 7 7|Dan.7:7, 19 8:9]] (יַתִּיר, יֶתֶר) 2Ma.8:27 2Mac 12:44 A * ;] beyond measure, exceedingly, abundantly: [[matthew 27 23|Mat.27:23]], [[mark 10 26|Mrk.10:26 15:14]], [[acts 26 11|Act.26:11]]. Compar. (a) περισσότερον (see: περισσός); (b) περισσοτέρως: [[2-corinthians 1 12|2Co.1:12 2:4 7:15 11:23]], [[galatians 1 14|Gal.1:14]], [[philippians 1 14|Php.1:14]], [[1-thessalonians 2 17|1Th.2:17]], [[hebrews 2 1|Heb.2:1 13:19]]; π. μᾶλλον, [[2-corinthians 7 13|2Co.7:13;]] opposite to ἧττον, [[2-corinthians 12 15|2Co.12:15.]]† (AS)
more superabundant rabundant, excess, far fetched, superfluous (in number, degree or character)
to a greater degree; especially, frequently, extremely more, more abundantly, more earnestly, more vehemently, [[2-corinthians 7 13|2Cor. 7:13;]] exceedingly, extremely [[galatians 1 14|Gal. 1:14]]

περισσῶς adv. (περισσός) [in LXX: [[psalms 31 23|Psa.31:23]] (יֶתֶר -עַל), Da TH [[daniel 7 7|Dan.7:7, 19 8:9]] (יַתִּיר, יֶתֶר) 2Ma.8:27 2Mac 12:44 A * ;] beyond measure, exceedingly, abundantly: [[matthew 27 23|Mat.27:23]], [[mark 10 26|Mrk.10:26 15:14]], [[acts 26 11|Act.26:11]]. Compar. (a) περισσότερον (see: περισσός); (b) περισσοτέρως: [[2-corinthians 1 12|2Co.1:12 2:4 7:15 11:23]], [[galatians 1 14|Gal.1:14]], [[philippians 1 14|Php.1:14]], [[1-thessalonians 2 17|1Th.2:17]], [[hebrews 2 1|Heb.2:1 13:19]]; π. μᾶλλον, [[2-corinthians 7 13|2Co.7:13;]] opposite to ἧττον, [[2-corinthians 12 15|2Co.12:15.]]† (AS)
περιστερά, -ᾶς, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for יוֹנָה ;] a dove: [[matthew 3 16|Mat.3:16 10:16 21:12]], [[mark 1 10|Mrk.1:10 11:15]], [[luke 2 24|Luk.2:24 3:22]], [[john 1 32|Jhn.1:32 2:14, 16]]† (AS)

περι-τέμνω [in LXX chiefly for מוּל ;] (Ion., Epic. and late writers), to cut around (Hdt.), hence, to circumcise (π. τὰ αἰδοῖα, Hdt.) : [[luke 1 59|Luk.1:59 2:21]], [[john 7 22|Jhn.7:22]], [[acts 7 8|Act.7:8 15:5 16:3 21:21]]. Pass. and mid., to be circumcised, receive circumcision: [[acts 15 1|Act.15:1]], [[1-corinthians 7 18|1Co.7:18]], [[galatians 2 3|Gal.2:3 5:2-3 6:12-13]] Metaphorical (cf. [[deuteronomy 10 16|Deu.10:16]], [[jeremiah 4 4|Jer.4:4]], al.), [[colossians 2 11|Col.2:11]] (see Deiss., BS, 151 f.; MM, xix).† (AS)

περι-τίθημι [in LXX for נָתַן, שׂוּם, etc. ;] to place or put around: with accusative and dative, [[matthew 21 33|Mat.21:33 27:48]], [[mark 12 1|Mrk.12:1 15:36]], [[john 19 29|Jhn.19:29]]; of garments, etc., to put on: [[matthew 27 28|Mat.27:28]] [[mark 15 17|Mrk.15:17]] (Sir.6:31). Metaphorical, like περιβάλλω, to bestow, confer (Thuc., al., [[esther 1 20|Est.1:20]]): [[1-corinthians 12 23|1Co.12:23]].† (AS)

περι-τομή, -ῆς, ἡ (περιτέμνω), [in LXX: [[genesis 17 13|Gen.17:13]], [[exodus 4 25|Exo.4:25-26]] (מוּל ni., מוּלָה), [[jeremiah 11 16|Jer.11:16]] * ;] circumcision; (a) of the rite itself : [[john 7 22|Jhn.7:22-23]] [[acts 7 8|Act.7:8]], [[romans 4 11|Rom.4:11]], [[galatians 5 11|Gal.5:11]], [[philippians 3 5|Php.3:5]]; (b) of the state of circumcision: [[romans 2 25|Rom.2:25-28 3:1]], [[1-corinthians 7 19|1Co.7:19]], [[galatians 5 6|Gal.5:6 6:15]], [[colossians 3 11|Col.3:11]]; ἐν π. ὤν, [[romans 4 10|Rom.4:10;]] (with) by meton., π. = οἱ περιτμηθέντες, the circumcised: [[romans 3 30|Rom.3:30 4:9, 12 15:8]], [[galatians 2 7|Gal.2:7-9]], [[ephesians 2 11|Eph.2:11]]; οἱ ἐκ τῆς π., of Jews, [[romans 4 12|Rom.4:12;]] of Jewish Christians, [[acts 11 2|Act.11:2]], [[galatians 2 12|Gal.2:12]], [[titus 1 10|Tit.1:10]]; οἱ ἐκ π. πιστοί, [[acts 10 45|Act.10:45;]] οἱ ὄντες ἐκ π., [[colossians 4 11|Col.4:11]] Metaphorical, [[romans 2 29|Rom.2:29]], [[colossians 2 11|Col.2:11]], [[philippians 3 3|Php.3:3]].† (AS)
περι-τρέπω [in LXX: Wis.5:23 * ;] to turn about, turn: with accusative and, dative, [[acts 26 24|Act.26:24]] (cf. FlJ, Ant., ix, 4, 4).† (AS)
περι-τρέχω [in LXX: [[amos 8 12|Amo.8:12]], [[jeremiah 5 1|Jer.5:1]] (שׁוּט pi.) * ;] to run about: with accusative loc., [[mark 6 55|Mrk.6:55.]]† (AS)

περι-φέρω [in LXX: [[ecclesiastes 7 8|Ecc.7:8]] (7) (הָלַל po.), al. ;] to carry about: [[mark 6 55|Mrk.6:55]], [[2-corinthians 4 10|2Co.4:10]]. Pass., metaphorically: [[ephesians 4 14|Eph.4:14.]]† (AS)

περι-φρονέω, -ῶ [in LXX: 4Ma.6:9 4Mac 14:1 * ;] 1. to examine on all sides, consider carefully (Aristoph.). 2. = ὑπερφρονέω, to have thouphts beyond, to despise (Thuc., Plut., al.; 4Mac, ll. with) : [[titus 2 15|Tit.2:15.]]† (AS)

περί-χωρος, -ον [in LXX: chiefly (ἡ π.) for כִּכָּר ;] round about, neighbouring (Dem., Plut., al.). In LXX and NT, as subst., ἡ π. (sc. γῆ), the region round about: [[matthew 14 35|Mat.14:35]], [[mark 1 28|Mrk.1:28]], [[luke 4 14|Luk.4:14, 37 7:17 8:37]], [[acts 14 6|Act.14:6]]; ἡ π. τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, [[luke 3 3|Luk.3:3;]] by meton. for the people of the same region, [[matthew 3 5|Mat.3:5.]]† (AS)

περί-ψημα, -τος, τό (περιψράω, to wipe off all round), [in LXX: Tob.5:18 * ;] that which is wiped off, offscouring: metaphorically (assoc. with περικάθαρμα, which see), [[1-corinthians 4 13|1Co.4:13]] (and so prob., To, l.with, as EV; but see Thayer, see word, for the meaning expiation, ransom, in To; and cf. LS, see word κάθαρμα; Lft., Notes, 200 f., and on Ign., Eph., 8).† (AS)
περπερεύοραι (περπερος, vainglorious) to boast or vaunt oneself: [[1-corinthians 13 4|1Co.13:4]] (elsewhere. only in Antonin.; see Abbott, Essays, 87).† (AS)

1. Persian , (Aeschulus Tragicus), etc. 2. as Substantive, (.] (entry γῆ); Persis, Persia , now Farsistan , (Herdotus Historicus) 3. (entry γυνή); a Persian woman , (Xenophon Historicus) 4. (entry χλαῖνα); a Persian cloak , (Aristophanes Comicus) (ML)
πέρυσι adv. (πέρας), last year, a year ago: ἀπὸ π. (as in π. see Deiss., BS, 221; LAE, 70), [[2-corinthians 8 10|2Co.8:10 9:2]].† (AS)

πετεινός, -ή, -όν (πέτομαι), [in LXX chiefly for עוֹף ;] in trag., Ion. and late writers, winged, flying; as subst., τὸ π., a winged fowl, a bird: pl., [[matthew 6 26|Mat.6:26 8:20 13:4, 32]], [[mark 4 4|Mrk.4:4, 32]], [[luke 8 5|Luk.8:5 9:58 12:24 13:19]], [[acts 10 12|Act.10:12 11:6]], [[romans 1 23|Rom.1:23]], [[james 3 7|Jas.3:7]].† (AS)

πέτομαι [in LXX chiefly for עוּף ;] to fly: [[revelation 4 7|Rev.4:7 8:13 12:14 14:6 19:17]] (Rec. πετάομαι, which see).† πετάομαι, [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 4 17|Deu.4:17]] * ;] false form of ποτάομαι, poët., frequentat. of πέτομαι (Aristoph., al.), Rec. for πέτομαι (which see, cf. Veitch, see word) (AS)

πέτρα, -ας, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for סֶלַע, צוּר ;] a rock, i.e. a mass of live rock as distinct from πέτρος, a detached stone or boulder : [[matthew 7 24|Mat.7:24-25 27:51, 60]] [[mark 15 46|Mrk.15:46]], [[luke 6 48|Luk.6:48 8:6, 13]]; of a hollow rock, a cave, [[revelation 6 15|Rev.6:15-16]] (of. [[isaiah 2 10|Isa.2:10]], al.). Metaphorical, [[matthew 16 18|Mat.16:18]] (on the meaning, see Hort, Eccl., 16 ff., but cf. also ICC, in l), [[1-corinthians 10 4|1Co.10:4;]] = πέτρος, [[romans 9 33|Rom.9:33]], [[1-peter 2 8|1Pe.2:8]]" (LXX) .† (AS)
Πέτρος, -ου, ὁ (i.e. a stone, see: πέτρα, Κηφᾶς), Simon Peter, the Apostle: [[matthew 4 18|Mat.4:18 10:2]], [[mark 3 16|Mrk.3:16]], [[luke 5 8|Luk.5:8]], [[john 1 41|Jhn.1:41, 43]], al. (AS)
Πέτρος, -ου, ὁ (i.e. a stone, see: πέτρα, Κηφᾶς), Simon Peter, the Apostle: [[matthew 4 18|Mat.4:18 10:2]], [[mark 3 16|Mrk.3:16]], [[luke 5 8|Luk.5:8]], [[john 1 41|Jhn.1:41, 43]], al. (AS)
Πέτρος, -ου, ὁ (i.e. a stone, see: πέτρα, Κηφᾶς), Simon Peter, the Apostle: [[matthew 4 18|Mat.4:18 10:2]], [[mark 3 16|Mrk.3:16]], [[luke 5 8|Luk.5:8]], [[john 1 41|Jhn.1:41, 43]], al. (AS)
πετρώδης, -ες (πέτρα, εἶδος), rock-like, rocky, stony: τὸ, τὰ π., of shallow soil with underlying rock, [[matthew 13 5|Mat.13:5, 20]], [[mark 4 5|Mrk.4:5, 16]].† (AS)

πήγανον, -ου, τό περισσότερον, -ως, see: περισσῶς περισσῶς adv. (περισσός) [in LXX: [[psalms 31 23|Psa.31:23]] (יֶתֶר -עַל), Da TH [[daniel 7 7|Dan.7:7, 19 8:9]] (יַתִּיר, יֶתֶר) 2Ma.8:27 2Mac 12:44 A * ;] beyond measure, exceedingly, abundantly: [[matthew 27 23|Mat.27:23]], [[mark 10 26|Mrk.10:26 15:14]], [[acts 26 11|Act.26:11]]. Compar. (a) περισσότερον (see: περισσός); (b) περισσοτέρως: [[2-corinthians 1 12|2Co.1:12 2:4 7:15 11:23]], [[galatians 1 14|Gal.1:14]], [[philippians 1 14|Php.1:14]], [[1-thessalonians 2 17|1Th.2:17]], [[hebrews 2 1|Heb.2:1 13:19]]; π. μᾶλλον, [[2-corinthians 7 13|2Co.7:13;]] opposite to ἧττον, [[2-corinthians 12 15|2Co.12:15.]]† (AS)

πηγή, -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for עַיִן, also for מָקוֹר, etc. ;] a spring, fountain : [[james 3 11|Jas.3:11]], [[2-peter 2 17|2Pe.2:17]]; τ. δάτων, [[revelation 8 10|Rev.8:10 14:7 16:4]]; of a well fed by a spring, [[john 4 6|Jhn.4:6;]] π. τοῦ αἵματος, of a flow of blood, [[mark 5 29|Mrk.5:29;]] metaphorically, [[john 4 14|Jhn.4:14]], [[revelation 7 17|Rev.7:17 21:6]].† (AS)
πήγνυμι [in LXX chiefly for נָטָה, also for תָּקַע, etc. ;] to make fast, to fix; of tents, to pitch: [[hebrews 8 2|Heb.8:2]] (cf. προσ-πήγνυμι).† (AS)
πηδάλιον, -συ, τό (πηδός, the blade of an oar), a rudder: [[james 3 4|Jas.3:4;]] pl., [[acts 27 40|Act.27:40.]]† (AS)

πηλίκος, -η, -ον [in LXX: [[zechariah 2 2|Zec.2:2]] (6) (כָּמַהּ), 4Ma.15:22 * ;] interrog., how large, how great ? (prop., of magnitude, as πόσος of quantity): in exclamations, = ἡλίκος (see Bl., § 51, 4), [[galatians 6 11|Gal.6:11;]] of personal greatness, [[hebrews 7 4|Heb.7:4.]]† (AS)

πηλός, οῦ, ἁ [in LXX chiefly for חֹמֶר, טִיט ] 1. clay, as used by a potter: [[romans 9 21|Rom.9:21]] (cf. [[isaiah 29 16|Isa.29:16]], al.). 2. - βόρβορος, wet clay, mud: [[john 9 6|Jhn.9:6, 11 9:14-15]] † (AS)

πἡρα, -ας, ἡ [in LXX: Jdth.10:5 13:10, 15 * ;] a leathern pouch for victuals, etc., a wallet (Deiss. thinks an alms-bag, see LAE, 108 ff.): [[matthew 10 10|Mat.10:10]], [[mark 6 8|Mrk.6:8]], [[luke 9 3|Luk.9:3 10:4 22:35-36]].† (AS)

πῆχυς, -εως genitive pl., -ῶν (for Att.. -εων, see WH, App., 157; Thackeray, Gr., 151; Deiss., BS, 153), [in LXX chiefly and frequently for אַמָּה ;] 1. the forearm (Hom.). 2. As a measure of length, a cubit: [[matthew 6 27|Mat.6:27]], [[luke 12 25|Luk.12:25]], [[john 21 8|Jhn.21:8]], [[revelation 21 17|Rev.21:17]].† (AS)

πιάζω (cf. MGr. πιάνω; see Kennedy, Sources, 155), Doric and late Att.. for πιέζω in its later senses [in LXX: [[song-of-solomon 2 15|Sng.2:15]] (אָחַז), Sir.23:21 * ;] 1. to lay hold of: [[acts 3 7|Act.3:7]] (Theocr.). 2. to take, capture, apprehend: [[john 7 30|Jhn.7:30, 32 7:44 8:20 10:39 11:57 21:3, 10]] [[acts 12 4|Act.12:4]], [[2-corinthians 11 32|2Co.11:32]], [[revelation 19 20|Rev.19:20]] (see MM, xx).† (AS)
πιέζω [in LXX : [[micah 6 15|Mic.6:15]] (דָּרַךְ)* ;] 1. to press, press down or to­gether: [[luke 6 38|Luk.6:38]] (cl). 2. Later, to seize (see: πιάζω).† (AS)

πιθανολογία, -ας, ἡ (πιθανός, persuasive, plausible), in cl. (Plat), the use of probable arguments, as opposite to demonstration (ἀπόδειξις); hence, persuasive speech: [[colossians 2 4|Col.2:4]] (see ICC, in l).† (AS)

πικραίνω (πικρός), [in LXX for מָרַד, קָצַף, etc. ;] to make bitter: [[revelation 10 9|Rev.10:9;]] pass., [[revelation 8 11|Rev.8:11 10:10]]; metaphorically, to embitter (LXX) : pass., before πρός, [[colossians 3 19|Col.3:19.]]† (AS)

πικρία, -ας, ἡ (πικρός), [in LXX chiefly for מַר and cognate forms ;] bitterness; (a) of taste (Arist., [[jeremiah 15 17|Jer.15:17]], al.); (b) metaphorically, of temper, character, etc.: [[romans 3 14|Rom.3:14]] (LXX), [[ephesians 4 31|Eph.4:31;]] ῥίζα πικρίας, [[hebrews 12 15|Heb.12:15;]] χολὴ π., a malignant disposition, [[acts 8 23|Act.8:23.]]† (AS)

πικρός, -ά, -όν (poët. in cl.), [in LXX chiefly for מַר ;] 1. sharp, pointed. 2. sharp to the senses; of taste, bitter: opposite to γλυκύ, [[james 3 11|Jas.3:11;]] metaphorically, harsh, bitter: [[james 3 14|Jas.3:14]] (AS)

πικρῶς adv. (πικρός), [in LXX for מַר, מָרַר pi. ;] bitterly: metaphorically, (cf. πικρὸν δάκρυον, Hom.), ἔκλαυσε π., [[matthew 26 75|Mat.26:75]], [[luke 22 62|Luk.22:62]] (see MM, xviii, see word παρακολουθέω).† (AS)

Πειλᾶτος (Rec. Πιλάτος, Tr., -ᾶτος, see WH, App., 155), -ου, ὁ, Pontius Pilate: [[matthew 27 2|Mat.27:2]], [[mark 15 1|Mrk.15:1]], [[luke 3 1|Luk.3:1]], [[john 18 29|Jhn.18:29]], [[acts 3 13|Act.3:13]], [[1-timothy 6 13|1Ti.6:13]], al (AS)

πίμπρημι (in cl. prose, rare in the simple form), [in LXX: [[numbers 5 21|Num.5:21-22, 27]] (צָבֶה) * ;] 1. to blow, burn. 2. Later, to cause to swell; mid., of parts of the body, to become swollen (LXX) : [[acts 28 6|Act.28:6]] (cf. ἐμπίπρημι).† (AS)
πινακίδιον, -ου, τό (dimin. of πινακίς, which see), [in Sm.: [[ezekiel 9 2|Eze.9:2]] * ;] a writing tablet: [[luke 1 63|Luk.1:63.]]† (AS)

πίναξ, -ακος, ὁ [in LXX: 4Ma.17:7 R * ;] prop., a board, plank; hence, of various at wooden articles; (a) a tablet; (b) a disc, a dish: [[matthew 14 8|Mat.14:8, 11]], [[mark 6 25|Mrk.6:25, 28]] [[luke 11 39|Luk.11:39]].† (AS)

πίνω [in LXX chiefly for שָׁתָה ;] to drink: absol., [[luke 2 19|Luk.2:19]], [[john 4 7|Jhn.4:7]], al.; with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 6 26|Mat.6:26, 31]] [[mark 14 25|Mrk.14:25]], al.; of habitual use, [[luke 1 15|Luk.1:15]], [[romans 14 21|Rom.14:21]], al.; by meton., τὸ ποτήριον, [[1-corinthians 10 21|1Co.10:21]], al.; of the earth absorbing rain (Hdt., al.), [[hebrews 6 7|Heb.6:7;]] spiritually, of the blood of Christ, [[john 6 53|Jhn.6:53-54, 56]]; before ἐκ (of the vessel), [[matthew 26 27|Mat.26:27]], al.; id. (of the drink; Bl., § 36, 1), [[matthew 26 29|Mat.26:29]], [[john 4 13|Jhn.4:13-14]] [[revelation 14 10|Rev.14:10]], al.; ἀπό, [[luke 22 18|Luk.22:18]] (cf. ἀπο-, συν-πίνω; on the form πίεσαι, [[luke 17 8|Luk.17:8]], see Bl., § 21, 8, and on the contr. aor. πεῖν, M, Pr., 44 f., Thackeray, Gr., 63 f.) (AS)
πιότης, -ητος, ἡ (πίων, fat), [in LXX chiefly for דֶּשֶׁן ;] fatness: [[romans 11 17|Rom.11:17.]]† (AS)

πιπράσκω [in LXX chiefly for מָכַר ni. ;] to sell: with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 13 46|Mat.13:46]] (on this pf., see Bl., § 59, 5), [[acts 2 45|Act.2:45 4:34 5:4]]; with genitive (of price), [[matthew 26 9|Mat.26:9]], [[mark 14 5|Mrk.14:5]], [[john 12 5|Jhn.12:5]]; with accusative of person(s) (of slavery), [[matthew 18 25|Mat.18:25;]] hence metaphorically, [[romans 7 14|Rom.7:14]] (cf. 4Ki.17:17, 1Ma.1:15, al.).† (AS)

πίπτω [in LXX chiefly for נָפַל ;] to fall; 1. of descent, to fall, fall down or from: before ἐπί, with accusative loc., [[matthew 10 29|Mat.10:29]], al.; εἰς, [[matthew 15 14|Mat.15:14]], al.; ἐς μέσῳ, with genitive, [[luke 8 7|Luk.8:7;]] παρὰ τ. ὁδόν, [[matthew 13 4|Mat.13:4]], [[mark 4 4|Mrk.4:4]], [[luke 8 5|Luk.8:5]]; before ἀπό, [[matthew 15 27|Mat.15:27]], al.; ἐκ, [[mark 13 25|Mrk.13:25]], [[luke 10 18|Luk.10:18]], [[revelation 8 10|Rev.8:10 9:1]]. Metaphorical: ὁ ἥλιος, before ἐπί, [[revelation 7 16|Rev.7:16;]] ἀχλὺς κ. σκότος, [[acts 13 11|Act.13:11;]] ὁ κλῆρος, [[acts 1 26|Act.1:26;]] ὑπὸ κρίσιν, [[james 5 12|Jas.5:12.]] 2. Of prostration, (a) of persons, to fall prostrate, prostrate oneself: χαμαί [[john 18 6|Jhn.18:6;]] before ἐπί, with accusative, [[matthew 17 6|Mat.17:6]], [[acts 9 4|Act.9:4]]; id. with genitive, [[mark 9 20|Mrk.9:20;]] πρὸς τ. πόδας, [[acts 5 10|Act.5:10]], [[revelation 1 17|Rev.1:17]]; πεσὼν ἐξέψυξε, [[acts 5 5|Act.5:5;]] of supplication, homage or worship: πρὸς (παρὰ, ἐπὶ) τ. πὸδας, [[mark 5 22|Mrk.5:22]], [[luke 8 41|Luk.8:41]], [[acts 10 25|Act.10:25]], al.; π. καὶ προσκυνεῖν, [[revelation 5 14|Rev.5:14 19:4]]; ptcp. with προσκυνεῖν, [[matthew 2 11|Mat.2:11]], al.; ἐνώπιον, [[revelation 4 10|Rev.4:10 5:8]]; ἐπὶ πρόσωπον, [[matthew 26 39|Mat.26:39]], al.; (b) of things, to fall, fall down: [[matthew 21 44|Mat.21:44]], [[luke 23 30|Luk.23:30]]; of falling to ruin and destruction, [[matthew 7 25|Mat.7:25]], [[acts 15 16|Act.15:16]], [[hebrews 11 30|Heb.11:30]]; ἔπεσε (timeless aorist; M, Pr.,134), [[revelation 18 2|Rev.18:2.]] Metaphorical: [[romans 11 11|Rom.11:11;]] πόθεν πέπτωκας, [[revelation 2 5|Rev.2:5;]] opposite to ἑστόναι, [[1-corinthians 10 12|1Co.10:12;]] to στήκειν, [[romans 14 4|Rom.14:4;]] of virtues, [[1-corinthians 13 8|1Co.13:8;]] of precepts, [[luke 16 17|Luk.16:17.]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἀντι-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, παρα-, περι-, προσ-, συν-πίπτω.) συν-πίπτω (Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX for נָפַל, etc. ;] to fall together, fall in, etc.: of a house (cf. MM, xxiv), [[luke 6 49|Luk.6:49.]]† (AS)
